page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor with an x86_64 architecture, providing 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 8 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The CPU operates at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz and includes a 35 MB L3 cache. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware accelerators.

Benchmark data reveals a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, such as stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests, fall into the bottom 25% tier, with single-threaded gzip compression performing in the bottom 10%. However, multi-core execution scales to average levels, as demonstrated by stress-ng multi-core, PassMark CPU, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression tests. Memory bandwidth remains consistently average across both cached small-block and uncached large-block reads and writes. For application workloads, the instance delivers average throughput in Redis SET operations, static web serving, and text generation for small and medium language models.

Network capabilities are defined by a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource density make it a stable option for workloads requiring predictable multi-threaded performance without the premium of high-frequency compute or massive memory arrays. Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and average multi-core capabilities, the ecs.sn2.3xlarge is best suited for general-purpose workloads such as static web serving, moderate database operations, and multi-threaded application servers that do not rely on local NVMe storage.
